title: ONI Companion settings.json (v1.1)
description: Written by the core to settings.json in its data folder (the app's data folder in Barry) with write-tmp-then-rename. Missing file or missing keys mean the defaults. Unknown keys are kept by the core and ignored.

zoomToDupeOnSelect.description: Default false. On: opening a duplicant page from the Colony tab also sends one focus command (the page Screen then carries onOpen). Off: only the Show in game button zooms.
